verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents a first-party bulk operation: bulk transfers to multiple recipients, available through the API docs and from the dashboard. That is the product's own capability, but the evidence only covers transfers. It has no detail on batch size, per-item status reporting or error handling, and no bulk actions for other resources. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond transfers (e.g., bulk refunds, bulk customer or subaccount management), documented batch limits and per-item result handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
